title: Hello, we’re PeteMart.
text: We’re Peter and Marta, often known together as PeteMart. This is our shared home on the web for things we make, learn, and want to remember.

title: Hello, we’re PeteMart.
text:
Why make a family website?
Because the nicest parts of the internet still feel handmade.
We wanted something more lasting than a social feed and less formal than a portfolio: a place where a technical deep dive can sit beside a trip report, a favorite recipe, or a tiny project that made us smile.


Think of it as a kitchen table with unusually good support for equations and source code.

title: Hello, we’re PeteMart.
text:
What you’ll find here


Ideas Notes, explanations, reading, and things we’re still figuring out.


Places Travels, meals, photographs, and details worth keeping.


Projects Experiments, tools, code, and other evidence of curiosity getting out of hand.


The site will grow as we do. For now, you can wander through the journal or check back when the next small wonder arrives.
